name: FA_LEASE_AMORT_SCHEDULES_INT
description: This table contains amortization schedules for each lease schedule.

columns.name: LEASE_AMORT_SCH_INTERFACE_ID
columns.description: Unique amortization schedule identification number.

columns.name: BATCH_NAME
columns.description: Unique user-defined name for a batch of records in the interface table.

columns.name: LEASE_NUMBER
columns.description: User-defined lease number of the lease.

columns.name: BOOK_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Name of the asset book in which lease schedule is recorded.

columns.name: ASSET_SCHEDULE_NUM
columns.description: Unique Identifier of an asset lease schedule.

columns.name: LEASE_INTERFACE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the lease interface row.

columns.name: LEASE_BOOKS_INTERFACE_ID
columns.description: Lease book interface identifier.

columns.name: LEASE_SCH_INTERFACE_ID
columns.description: Lease schedule interface identifier.

columns.name: LEASE_ID
columns.description: Unique lease identification number.

columns.name: LEASE_SCHEDULE_ID
columns.description: Unique lease payment schedule identification number.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_NAME
columns.description: Transaction name for the asset. Free text field. No validations.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Classification of the lease transaction. Possible values are CREATE, UPDATE, and DELETE.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: WORKER_ID
columns.description: Internal identifier for parallel processing.

columns.name: ERROR_MSG
columns.description: Error message detailing failure of the posting program.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Oracle Fusion Enterprise Resource Planning: process ID of the process that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: POSTING_STATUS
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Status of the lease schedule.

columns.name: LEASE_AMORT_SCHEDULE_ID
columns.description: Unique amortization schedule identification number.

columns.name: INVOICE_DATE
columns.description: Date of the periodic lease payment invoice.

columns.name: INTEREST_DUE_DATE
columns.description: Periodic lease payment amount that the lessee pays to the lessor.

columns.name: DATE_EFFECTIVE
columns.description: Identifies effective start date of payment.

columns.name: DATE_INEFFECTIVE
columns.description: Identifies in-effective start date of payment after change in payment amount.

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Asset book period name in which the interest due date falls.

columns.name: LEASE_PAYMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Periodic lease payment amount that the lessee pays to the lessor.

columns.name: INTEREST_AMOUNT
columns.description: Interest amount included in the periodic lease payment.

columns.name: PRINCIPAL_REDUCTION_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount of periodic lease payment that reduce the lease liability.

columns.name: LIABILITY_AMOUNT
columns.description: Running lease liability balance.

columns.name: AMORTIZED_LEASE_COST
columns.description: Amount of total lease cost taken to lease expense for each asset book period.

columns.name: IMPAIRMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Impairment loss amount of the leased asset.

columns.name: LEASE_COST_BALANCE
columns.description: Running total lease cost balance.

columns.name: INDEX_RATE
columns.description: Price index value for the asset book period.

columns.name: CURRENT_LEASE_PAYMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Lease payment amount that the lessee pays to the lessor before the change of lease contract terms.

columns.name: NEW_LEASE_PAYMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Lease payment amount that the lessee pays to the lessor after the change of lease contract terms.

columns.name: CHANGE_IN_LEASE_PAYMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Increase or decrease in lease payment amount due to the change in lease contract terms.

columns.name: CURRENT_LEASE_LIABILITY_AMOUNT
columns.description: Lease liability amount that the lessee pays to the lessor before the change of lease contract terms.

columns.name: NEW_LEASE_LIABILITY_AMOUNT
columns.description: Lease liability amount that the lessee pays to the lessor after the change of lease contract terms.

columns.name: CHANGE_LEASE_LIABILITY_AMOUNT
columns.description: Increase or decrease in lease liability amount due to the change in lease contract terms.

columns.name: REASSESS_COST_CHANGE
columns.description: Increase or decrease in leased asset cost due to the change in lease contract terms.

columns.name: INVOICE_PROCESS_ID
columns.description: Invoice transfer process run identifier that transfers the lease payment invoice to Oracle Fusion Payables.

columns.name: REASSESS_GAIN_LOSS_AMOUNT
columns.description: Gain or loss to the lessee on lease contract terms change.

columns.name: INVOICE_GENERATED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether invoice is generated for the periodic lease payment.

columns.name: INTEREST_ACCRUED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether interest on lease liability is calculated for the asset book period.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_CREATED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether change in cost and liability due to changes in lease term is posted to the leased assets.

columns.name: LEASE_SCHEDULE_ITEM_ID
columns.description: Identification number of the payment type that was used to create the current line.

columns.name: EXCLUDE_FROM_LIABILITY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the line was created after excluding the lease liability.

columns.name: EXCLUDE_FROM_COST_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the line was created after excluding the lease cost.

columns.name: ADVANCE_PAYMENT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the line was created by an advance lease payment item.

columns.name: VARIABLE_PAYMENT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the line was created by a variable lease payment item.

columns.name: INITIAL_PAYMENT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the line was created by an initial lease payment item.

columns.name: PERIOD_PAYMENT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the line was created by a periodic lease payment item.

columns.name: PURCHASE_PAYMENT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the line was created by a purchase lease payment item.

columns.name: TERMINAL_PAYMENT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the line was created by a terminal lease payment item.

columns.name: RESIDUAL_PAYMENT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the line was created by a residual lease payment item.

columns.name: OTHER_PAYMENT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the line was created by another lease payment item.

columns.name: LEASE_EXPENSE_SUMMARY_ID
columns.description: Lease expense summary identification number.

columns.name: INVOICE_REFERENCE_ID
columns.description: Reference identifier for the current row in Oracle Fusion Payables.
